chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 434: Li Huowang Kidnaps a Heart-Element & Learns a Cosmic Truth
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang kidnaps the Zuowandao's North Wind during a chaotic battle. The interrogation reveals a shocking truth about the nature of reality itself.
og_description: A brutal interrogation leads to a devastating cosmic revelation that challenges the very foundations of Li Huowang's world.
twitter_title: Li Huowang just pulled off a HEIST
twitter_description: He kidnapped a body-swapping Heart-Element and all he got was this existential crisis. 💀📖

lore_anchors.definition: A Chinese symbol of inseparable love, here corrupted to represent a dangerous duplication or split within a divine or monstrous entity, where two opposing natures grow from the same source.
An aspect of the Siming Doumu, this facet governs falsehood and illusion, making it a key deity for the Zuowandao.
The hypothesized counterpart to the Doumu of Grand Yin, this facet is claimed by North Wind to govern truth and reality.
A painful and corrupt ascension path from the *Thousand Greats Record*; undergoing it multiple times amplifies the practitioner's pain sensitivity to a horrific degree.
A foundational Daoist concept of the primordial energy of the universe; in the novel, it is the source of the Heart-Element's reality-twisting power and accompanying hallucinations.
